checks.name: P_15 = Σ P_13_x + Σ P_14_x over the FA(3) buckets (house candidate; not stated by the sources) [FA3-XSD, MF-BROSZURA]
checks.abstain: UNSOURCED. Neither the FA(3) XSD nor the MF information sheet (2026-03-04) states P_15 = Σ P_13_x + Σ P_14_x. P_15 is 'Kwota należności ogółem' (total amount due), and the sheet (p.52) names cases where it is something else: the payment documented (advance invoices), the amount remaining (art. 106f ust. 3 invoices) and the correction (corrective invoices). The formula over the full FA(3) bucket set is kept as the candidate until a source states it

checks.guard_reason: P_10 (discounts not already in the net unit price) is not stated as per unit or per line in the FA(3) XSD or the MF sheet (pp.90-91); P_9B / P_11A mark the gross method of art. 106e ust. 7-8, where the sheet says the gross unit price and gross value replace the net ones (p.90)
